name: Psiphon Tunnel
description:
Psiphon in the top bar. A miner mole shows whether the tunnel is open, through which country, how fast, and who goes through it. Pick the country, point the system proxy at the tunnel, and close it carefully: if programs still use it, it offers to wait until they close.

Needs Psiphon's console client in ~/psiphon; install.sh from the repository sets it up.
